scripts.build: bun run --filter @king-fun/frontend build && bun run check:build-budget
scripts.lint: bun run --filter @king-fun/frontend lint && bun run --filter @king-fun/backend lint
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter @king-fun/frontend typecheck && bun run --filter @king-fun/backend typecheck
scripts.test: bun test frontend/src backend/tests backend/security scripts
scripts.test:e2e: bun run check:dependencies && bun run --filter @king-fun/frontend test:e2e
scripts.check: bun run check:dependencies && bun run check:policy && bun run check:release-contracts && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run security:audit && bun run build
scripts.install:e2e-browser: bun run check:dependencies && bun run --filter @king-fun/frontend install:e2e-browser
